case.rawTerms: Monthly-only live test synthetic offer:50 USD per month. Annual billing is not offered. Category software.30 days notice.
case.sourceNote: Explicit synthetic software pricing for live API E2E test

proposal.rationale: The terms say "50 USD per month" and "Annual billing is not offered." There is no annual price, so the floor check (lowest weekly balance minus annual upfront price) can't be run. Against the reserve_floor of 500, the lowest weekly balance is 1500 over the 12-week horizon_weeks. Twelve monthly payments would total 600 USD. Monthly looks affordable, but the rules say to escalate when no annual price is given. A person should confirm whether monthly-only is acceptable. The category is "software" and the notice period is "30 days notice."

cash_fit.note: Monthly cash flow is comfortable against the reserve_floor of 500, but there is no annual price to compare.

terms_clarity.note: Monthly price, currency, category and notice are explicit. The annual price is absent by design.

vendor_signals.note: The text calls itself a synthetic test offer, which is a weak credibility signal.

policy_fit.note: The price is small, but policy requires escalation when no annual price exists.
